export default function UserStats({ users }: UserStatsProps) { const totalUsers = users.length const activeCount = users.filter((u) => u.isActive).length const inactiveCount = totalUsers - activeCount const activePercentage = totalUsers > 0 ? (activeCount / totalUsers) * 100 : 0 return (

User Statistics

Active Users: {activeCount}

Inactive Users: {inactiveCount}

Active Percentage: {activePercentage}%

) }
